---
title: "Post GWAS Analyses"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = F, warning = F)
```

```{r}
library(gwaspr)
```

The function `run_Summary()` can be used to check which models have been ran on each trait.

```{r}
run_Summary(folder = "GWAS_Results")
```

The function `is_ran()` can be used to check if all if your triats in your myY object have been run successfully.

```{r}
is_Ran(folder = "GWAS_Results", myY = read.csv("gwaspr_myY.csv"))
```
